title: The Network
description: Ah, the restaurant biz in Nivalis... welcome to the grind. It might be worth it to make a few friends and learn the lay of the land. Just be careful who you get wrapped up with.

objectives.title: Talk with Ava
objectives.description: Maybe you made a mistake by turning Edison down. Ava could probably tell you.

objectives.title: Escape a Health Inspection
objectives.description: Rumor has it CorpSec is conducting health raids. Better make sure everything is in tip-top condition.

objectives.title: Wait for Ava to Track Down Edison
objectives.description: Surely Ava will get in touch with Edison... Just be patient.

objectives.title: Maybe Ava Knows How to Ditch the Fine
objectives.description: You were fined... Talk with Ava and learn how to get out of it.

objectives.title: Talk Your Way into Meeting the Notary
objectives.description: Cirian Krell knows how to find the Notary. Convince her to tell you how.

objectives.title: See if Ava Knows More About Cirian
objectives.description: Chat with Ava about your encounter with Cirian.

objectives.title: Report Back to Edison
objectives.description: Report back to Edison on what happened with Cirian.

objectives.title: Talk With Mica Rain
objectives.description: Talk with Mica Rain... Choose your words carefully. Don't implicate yourself!

objectives.title: Ask Ava if she knows what just happened?!
objectives.description: Get some advice from Ava.

objectives.title: Time to Take a Trip to Conland Containers
objectives.description: Pay Edison a visit.

objectives.title: See What Edison Has to Say
objectives.description: See what Edison has to say... And apparently don't touch anything.

objectives.title: See What Edison Has to Say
objectives.description: See what Edison has to say.

objectives.title: Find Out What One of the Twins is Doing On the Island
objectives.description: Talk with Alexander.

objectives.title: Talk with Reehan, the Captain
objectives.description: Find this Reehan character and pick their brain.

objectives.title: Talk With Mica Rain
objectives.description: Talk with Mica Rain... Choose your words carefully. Don't implicate yourself!

objectives.title: See if Finlay Has a Gift for Freya
objectives.description: Talk to Finlay Basin and see if you can get a gift for Freya.

objectives.title: Talk with Finn
objectives.description: Talk with Finn and see if he has anything kicking around for you.

objectives.title: Why is the Other Twin Here?
objectives.description: Find out why Alexandria is here.

objectives.title: Seize the Chance to Talk with Freya
objectives.description: Now's your chance to talk with Freya. Better make it worth it.

objectives.title: Settle With Mica Once and For All
objectives.description: Find out why Mica is at your shop.

objectives.title: Make Amends with Edison
objectives.description: Maybe one last conversation with Edison will put everything to rest.

objectives.title: Talk with Edison
objectives.description: Edison has returned to the Noodle Bar. Have a word with him!

objectives.title: Out of Stock?
objectives.description: Visit Banor to see if he knows where you can find Windowpane Lager.

objectives.title: Find Harmony
objectives.description: Banor mentioned someone named Harmony. Should find her.

objectives.title: Check out of Conland Containers
Talk to the CorpSec Detective
objectives.description: Talk to Mica Rain waiting for you at the Noodle Bar.

objectives.title: Talk to Edison
objectives.description: Edison shows up at the shop after pulling some strings. Talk to him!

objectives.title: Visit the Gen Debtor Hideout in the Stacks
objectives.description: Visit The Stacks and find the hideout Edison is using for the Gen Debtors.

objectives.title: Travel to Helix Monumental to find the Notary
objectives.description: Travel to Helix Monumental and find Edison's contact.

objectives.title: Visit the Stacks to Check on the Gen Debtors
objectives.description: Edison said the kids might be hungry. Should bring them something to eat

objectives.title: Visit the Stacks
objectives.description: Visit the Stacks.

objectives.title: Find a way to Calypso Island
objectives.description: Find a way to Calypso Island.

objectives.title: Travel to Metro Hub and Find Finn Amano
objectives.description: Travel to the Metro Hub and find the musician Finn Amano.

objectives.title: Visit the Oil Rig and Look for Finlay
objectives.description: Travel out to the Oil Rig and find Finlay.

objectives.title: Run Your Gift by Reehan
objectives.description: Check with Reehan to see if your gift is enough.

objectives.title: Get Yourself to Meridian Market
objectives.description: Get yourself to Meridian Market... Now!

objectives.title: Wait and Hope that Edison Comes Through
objectives.description: Edison said he'd take care of the fine, guess there's nothing to do but wait and see if he comes through.

objectives.title: Head Home
objectives.description: Maybe you should head home and think about the choices you've made...

objectives.title: Find Odin's Pub in the Industrial District
objectives.description: Travel to the Industrial District and find Odin's Pub.

objectives.title: Deliver the IDs to the Gen Debtors
objectives.description: Make the ID drop and give the Gen Debtors a new lease on life.

objectives.title: Drop off a Meal for the Gen Debtors
objectives.description: Drop off the food for the Gen Debt children, then scram.

objectives.title: Drop off the Package for the Gen Debt Kids
objectives.description: Drop off the items for the Gen Debt kids.

objectives.title: You've Got a Delivery
objectives.description: Check your Noodle Bar for a delivery.
